name: retdec
notes: Homebrew's Apple Silicon bottle (formula retdec 5.0, native arm64: no Rosetta any more). bin/retdec-decompiler links to /opt/homebrew/bin/retdec-decompiler and the run wrapper calls it directly. The earlier x86_64 build is kept aside in bin.local-build/. test.sh passed on 2026-10-16 (ok for mips, ppc and arm, then PASS). Upstream's last release is v5.0 (2022-12-08); the repo is still active. Output is C-like first-pass code, not byte-exact.
